description: Analyze epics and dependencies to generate a phased parallel execution plan — optimal batch grouping, critical path, and ready-to-run dispatch commands. Accepts --epics or --stories to scope the plan.
Full sprint lifecycle — story prep → dev → code review → QA → fix loop per story then closure. Sprint does not close until all Critical/High findings are resolved.
outputs: sprint closure artifacts and updated sprint-status/backlog/archived.yaml

description: Full epic lifecycle — sprint grouping → sprint execution loop → epic-level closure. Epic does not close until all Critical/High findings and undocumented drift are resolved.
outputs: epic closure artifacts and updated sprint-status/backlog/archived.yaml
